title: Why Are You Running?
blurb: Genuine bewilderment escalating into full pursuit inside a couple of seconds. The line comes from a Nigerian film scene that went global around 2018 and became the internet's default chase audio almost immediately, helped enormously by the fact that the question is entirely reasonable and will never be answered. Lay it over any footage of something fleeing — pets who have stolen food, toddlers with an escape plan, a robot vacuum retreating from a spill, your own motivation on a Monday morning. A certified hall-of-famer, no retirement in sight.
origin: From a Nollywood film scene that went globally viral around 2018.
